item.title: Match Report: Bristol Rovers 2-0 Walsall
item.description: Walsall fell to defeat on the road on Tuesday evening as two goals in the second half were the difference against Bristol Rovers at the Memorial Stadium. The sides were locked together going into the interval, but two-quick fire goals for The Gas ensured that they secured all three points. Mat Sadler made three changes to the side that drew with Chesterfield on Saturday. item.title: Sadler disappointed with nature of defeat to Bristol Rovers
item.description: Head Coach Mat Sadler was disappointed with the nature of the defeat to Bristol Rovers on Tuesday evening, with the Saddlers losing 2-0 at the Memorial Stadium. An even first half saw the scores level at the break, but goals in quick succession from Yusuf Akhamrich and Kofi Balmer in the second half saw the Gas walk away with all three points. “It was a tough one to take,” Sadler said. “I thought, for large parts, we played well. item.title: Jago Godden joins the Saddlers & heads to Drogheda United
item.description: We are pleased to announce the signing of midfielder Jago Godden! item.title: Saddlers Support Amelia at Tomorrow’s Match Against Barnet
item.description: At tomorrow’s match against Barnet, we will be coming together to support a young girl from the West Midlands to help make her upcoming birthday extra special. Seven-year-old Amelia Kolpa, from Rowley Regis, has been bravely battling stage-4 neuroblastoma since a young age. As she approaches her eighth birthday, Amelia shared a simple but powerful wish - to receive as many birthday cards as possible. item.description: Head Coach Mat Sadler said how he is looking forward to getting on the front foot this weekend as Walsall return to the Pallet-Track Bescot Stadium to take on Barnet.
